what: SPEED-RT BB stage's timing sets (stage 2 of SPEED-RT: BB72 and the gross code). The three sets are drawn once on Alpine by speed_rt/bb/draw.sh after the stage's beacon; every chunk is 10,000 shots of the frozen bb.shots sampler (Stim 1.16.0) at the chunk's seed (speed_rt/sets.py: TAG 'convlines speed-rt <set>'). The stage's beacon record names this file (sets_file).

srt-bb72-p3.feeds: pod BB72: the routing read (r12, chunks 0-19), the CPU terms BB72-3S and BB72-3F (routed shots in order), the baselines at p = 0.3 % (chunk 0), CUDA-Q (chunk 0)

srt-bb72-p2.feeds: pod BB72: the routing read (r12, chunks 0-29), the CPU terms BB72-2S and BB72-2F, the baselines at p = 0.2 % (chunk 0), CUDA-Q (chunk 0)

srt-gross-p4.feeds: pods gross-balanced and gross-accurate: the routing read (g2, chunks 0-14), the CPU terms G-4R and G-4F, the baselines (chunk 0), CUDA-Q (chunk 0)
